query: How do I make a paper airplane?

goal.title: Fold a white paper airplane
goal.description: Fold a white rectangular sheet lengthwise and smooth the center crease, then open it again. Fold the two corners at one end inward to meet the center line and crease them firmly. Fold the next pair of side edges toward the center, fold the pointed section back and repeat inward folds on both sides. Close the shaped paper along its center crease, fold one wing down, turn it over and fold the other wing to match. Lift the airplane, spread and adjust its wings and hold it up for inspection.
goal.final_state: A white paper airplane with a pointed nose and two spread wings is held above the table. No flight is shown.
procedure: Make and reopen a lengthwise center crease.
Fold matching corners and side edges towards the center.
Fold back the pointed section and narrow both sides again.
Fold the airplane in half and crease both wings.
Spread and align the wings and hold up the finished airplane.

phases.description: Fold the rectangular sheet in half lengthwise, press the fold flat and reopen it.
Fold both upper corners to the center and then bring each sloping side inward, pressing the creases.
Fold the pointed section back, bring both long edges inward and close the paper along the center.
Lift and pinch the center fold, fold down one wing, turn the airplane and fold its matching wing, then spread and align both wings.
